newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Rail, IC, Grain Systems in pact.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Rail, IC, Grain Systems in pact.

text.p: Pioneer Railcorp said Wednesday it reached a marketing pact with Illinois Central Corp and Grain Systems Inc that will expand its freight shipping capabilities to major U.S. and Canadian ports.
The agreement will boost revenues and carloads shipped through Poineer's Decatur Junction Railway operation, the company said. Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

Initially Decatur Junction will ship Grain Systems containers from Assumption, Ill., to various Gulf of Mexico ports, including the Port of New Orleans, and to Canada, including the Port of Montreal. From there the commodities will be transported by container ships worldwide.
"The transaction is a major opportunity for Decatur Junction to provide intermodal service to North American ports for the first time ever," said Guy Brenkman, Pioneer's chairman and chief executive.
